description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340011657717 CLA MP,LOOP: Line 0001 Qty 2247 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0113 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 337. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 22175 SS7563-6NBCL; 83930 SS7563-6NBCL; 84971 SS7563-6NBCL. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
